description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (Federated)," illustrates the proportion of different token routing strategies used in a communication-efficient system. The chart is divided into three distinct segments: a large green segment labeled "LOCAL" representing 94.5% of the total, a red segment labeled "LLM" accounting for 3.9%, and a small blue segment labeled "EDGE_P2P" making up 1.6%. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the "LOCAL" category dominating the distribution. The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart uses a simple color scheme to differentiate the categories.
